references.label: Center post-raising target
references.description: Target above the lower rollover field that raises the post between the flippers.

references.label: Bonus collect hole
references.description: Eject hole that scores the lit 1,000–10,000 bonus and resets it.

references.label: Top and left Firecracker spin-score holes
references.description: Eject holes that rotate and advance the feature unit before awarding its stopped value.

references.label: Randomly lit Extra Ball target
references.description: Target that awards an extra ball only while its moving lamp is lit.

references.label: Left outlane kickback
references.description: Randomly lit outlane save that returns the ball to play.

references.label: Right free-ball gate
references.description: One-way gate that sends the ball back to the shooter lane and scores 3,000 while lit.
